valBuild.useProjectLanguageServer.markdownDescription:
Use the language server that ships with the Val installed in your project (`@valbuild/language-server`) instead of the one bundled with this extension.

One published extension then works against many versions of Val. Features the project's server serves are switched off in the bundled one, so nothing is reported twice.

You do not install `@valbuild/language-server` yourself — it ships inside `@valbuild/next`, `@valbuild/tanstackstart-react` or `@valbuild/cli`, whichever your project depends on. There is no minimum version of `@valbuild/core`.

Off by default while the two servers reach parity. Run **Val: Show Language Server Info** to see what resolved.

valBuild.languageServerPath.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to a `@valbuild/language-server` entry point, used instead of resolving one from the project's `node_modules`.

Needed under Yarn PnP, where there is no `node_modules` to resolve through, and useful for developing against an unreleased Val by pointing at a monorepo checkout's `packages/language-server/bin.js`. The `VAL_LANGUAGE_SERVER_PATH` environment variable does the same and is used when this is empty.

Only has an effect when `#valBuild.useProjectLanguageServer#` is on.
